value.name: credential-derivation-private
value.premises: The borrowed operations write only caller-owned destinations, Error has no payload, and no result contains private bytes. Inputs remain protected by their caller. For salted_password, mac and stored_key, the host exit labels delimit the host borrows. The host residue disposition is limited to the primitive temporaries named by ROOT::amend:storage:scram-residue; it admits no unnamed temporary or new consumer. The verifier formatter has no admitted production consumer. Its borrows and primitive temporaries, including encoder copies of stored-key and server-key bytes, are owed to its first consumer's inventory review; no host residue disposition is inherited. The two manual Debug implementations emit fixed role markers without reading or formatting the borrowed bytes; they perform no primitive derivation.
